scripts.setup: pnpm install && (cd backend && npm ci) && ${PYTHON:-python3} -m venv agents/.venv && agents/.venv/bin/pip install -q -e 'agents[dev]'
scripts.build:checker: cd checker && cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip2 && shasum -a 256 target/wasm32-wasip2/release/nixo_checker.wasm
scripts.build:contract: cd contract && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm
scripts.build:vault: cd vault && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm
scripts.build:copykeys: cd copykeys && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm
scripts.test: cd checker && cargo test && cd ../contract && cargo test && cd ../vault && cargo test && cd ../copykeys && cargo test && cd ../agents && .venv/bin/pytest -q && pnpm test:solver
scripts.build:checker-preview: cd checker && cargo build --release --locked --target wasm32-wasip1 && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/nixo_checker.wasm ../web/lib/checker/nixo_checker_preview.wasm && shasum -a 256 ../web/lib/checker/nixo_checker_preview.wasm
